what: Plan omits surviving Step 3 lint harness updates
scenario_or_breakage: The plan shrinks or deletes the Step 3 shell bodies, but make lint still runs these harnesses. They currently grep for wrapper internals, lib-step3-prelaunch-failure.sh, and RUN_STEP3_PLAN_REVIEW_LOOP_SH stub seams, so verification can fail after the proposed port.
suggested_fix: Add these harnesses and needed sibling docs to the file list. Retarget them to the native plan_review CLI or function seams, or retarget their Makefile entries, while preserving only wrapper-owned contracts.
